newsitem.title: USA: Mitsubishi Motors to sell brands in Canada.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Motors to sell brands in Canada.

text.p: Mitsubishi Motors Motor Sales of America Inc, the U.S. subsidiary of Mitsubishi Motors Corp of Japan said on Wednesday it will begin selling Mitsubishi branded cars in Canada from January 1998.

The company said it had already established an initial company in Canada through a new subsidiary, MMSA Distribution Services Canada Inc, located in temporary offices in Mississauga, Ontario. This company will complete all the initial planning and recruiting for the new Canadian distribution operations.
Mitsubishi did not release details regarding the products to be sold in Canada nor the policy related to dealer selection.
Mitsubishi has already sold some vehicles in Canada under Chrysler Corp brand names, such as the Dodge Colt and Eagle Summit.
